vertex_primary_terms_map.facts: Express mode is documented as Preview, uses publisher-model API-key endpoints and transitions out of the 90-day free tier after billing. Its Preview label references Pre-GA terms.
vertex_primary_terms_map.bil_boundary: Endpoint identity/paid billing previously evidenced; applicable express-mode contractual exception remains unverified.

vertex_primary_terms_map.facts: Pre-GA data-processing/CDPA coverage is absent unless expressly provided by written notice/documentation; personal or regulated data should not be processed under the default rule. Training requires prior customer permission/instruction. Under-18-directed or likely-accessed apps, clinical use and substitute professional medical advice are restricted. Handling clauses do not establish zero retention.
vertex_primary_terms_map.bil_boundary: HIGH legal/privacy clearance GAP, potentially release BLOCKER: prove applicable written/documentation exception and actual wellness/18+ conditions; no BIL-specific legal violation inferred.

vertex_primary_terms_map.facts: Managed models exclude training absent permission/instruction. Abuse monitoring may log prompts; request-response logging is separately configurable. Default isolated in-memory caching has a 24-hour TTL; Google describes it as compatible with its zero-data-retention definition. Interactions/grounding/Live API have separate retention conditions, but those APIs are not present in the inspected generateContent request.
vertex_primary_terms_map.bil_boundary: Project logging/caching/abuse exemption not read. Do not infer ephemeral real-time processing or zero retained logs from default guidance; no installed BIL retention duration measured.

vertex_primary_terms_map.facts: The applicable CDPA describes processor/controller roles, instructed processing and deletion/security obligations.
vertex_primary_terms_map.bil_boundary: Public terms are not evidence of BIL-specific accepted coverage, especially the Pre-GA exception boundary.

vertex_primary_terms_map.facts: A different Interactions API feature explicitly permits personal-data processing under its CDPA notice.
vertex_primary_terms_map.bil_boundary: This demonstrates that express documentation exceptions can exist; it does NOT prove that BIL's generateContent Express path has the same exception. Do not transfer the exception across APIs.
